stem.en: How is the entry in row i, column j of a matrix product AB obtained?
stem.et: Kuidas saadakse maatriksite korrutise AB element real i ja veerus j?

label.en: As the dot product of row i of A with column j of B
label.et: A maatriksi rea i ja B maatriksi veeru j skalaarkorrutisena

label.en: By multiplying the corresponding entries of A and B
label.et: Korrutades A ja B vastavad elemendid

label.en: By multiplying every entry of A by every entry of B and summing
label.et: Korrutades iga A elemendi iga B elemendiga ja liites

label.en: It exists only if both matrices are invertible
label.et: See on olemas ainult siis, kui mõlemad maatriksid on pööratavad
